name: nimblebrain
description: Experimental. Run NimbleBrain on your own machine with its showcase and GlassEngine apps, connect Codex to both, and answer in NimbleBrain from a Codex session.

interface.longDescription: Experimental. Sets up NimbleBrain on your machine, connects Codex to the local showcase (127.0.0.1:27280) and GlassEngine (127.0.0.1:27281) apps, and adds a skill that puts this Codex session in its own chat tab inside NimbleBrain.
defaultPrompt: Join GlassEngine as codex and keep answering
